scope: Synthetic public lifecycle contract shared by both shells. Case definitions are requirements, not execution results or provider/device support evidence. Addresses, routes and target IDs are fictitious; no credentials or authorized host.

cases.name: same-host-independent-targets
expected: distinct immutable tab IDs
same host does not merge views
draft and input target remain independent

cases.name: foreground-hide-keeps-authenticated-ssh
expected: direct-pane-a observer stopped or safely paused
direct-pane-a authenticated SSH retained
direct-pane-a input revoked before focus transfer
mesh-pane-b remains usable
no automatic reconnect or node stop

cases.name: explicit-resume-revalidates-original-target
actions: receive full with new observation epoch
expected: show alone does not resume
same original SSH and actual route used
snapshot pane and terminal IDs match original
new full precedes input capability
input stays observe until explicit user mode change

cases.name: replacement-refuses-resume
actions: snapshot w1:p1 now points to term_new
expected: reject replaced target
do not follow same pane name to new terminal
do not display old epoch frames as current
do not redial or send

cases.name: close-is-local
expected: mesh-pane-b remains connected
shared native node stop count unchanged
closed view rejects late callbacks

cases.name: affected-host-and-profile-only
expected: both direct host views revoked
mesh-pane-b unaffected
no auto activation or input on neighboring tab

cases.name: background-closes-all
expected: revoke all input and pending composition
close all SSH including hidden
do not automatically reconnect or resume after foreground

cases.name: unknown-is-not-a-draft
actions: submit from direct-pane-a then lose result
expected: unknown stays associated with original complete target and route
submitted bytes are not restored into sendable draft
no replay
other view observation is not cancelled

cases.name: discard-unsent-on-hide
expected: queued not-yet-submitted bytes discarded
submitted in-flight input handled as unknown if result unavailable
no queued bytes reach another tab

cases.name: late-observation-epoch
actions: pause with old full or ack pending
resume original target with new epoch and sequence 1
expected: old epoch cannot satisfy new full or release new ack
control/cancel works while frame ack pending
at most one bounded observer per view

cases.name: connection-capacity-includes-closing
expected: reject ninth while 8 are occupied
closing still counts until settled
do not reuse old tab or attempt IDs
slot becomes available only after actual cleanup

cases.name: binding-change-requires-new-view
actions: bind a page to system route
replace its network binding with mesh route
expected: old connector cannot be used for new route
original input and observer revoked
explicit close/reopen and review required
no system route fallback

evidenceRules: Report model, transport/loopback, GUI automation and device runs separately for each case.
A shared fixture copy or a green model test does not establish real GUI integration.
Actual TS/ET/ZT and platform combinations retain their independent acceptance matrix.
One-global-recovery-marker limitations must be stated; do not silently clear another view marker.
